# Gautam's Mayura Package Tours

> Bengaluru-based travel operator running its own AC sleeper/Volvo coach fleet since 1990. Books multi-day tour packages and day trips across South & Central India, plus corporate and group bus charters.

Mayura Package Tours is a Karnataka Tourism–licensed operator headquartered in Gandhi Nagar, Bengaluru. It owns and GPS-tracks its own coach fleet (no contract buses), and sells both curated packages and direct bus/charter bookings.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.mayurapackagetours.com/): overview, hero categories, curated packages, destinations, fleet, and booking/contact panel.
- Packages section (`/#packages`): all-inclusive tour packages with pricing, duration, and inclusions.
- Destinations section (`/#destinations`): quick links to individual destinations served from Bengaluru.
- Fleet section (`/#fleet`): coach types and amenities.
- Trust section (`/#trust`): credentials, ratings, and booking-platform listings.
- Contact section (`/#contact`): phone, WhatsApp, email, office address, and a quote-request form.

## Popular destinations

Goa, Ooty & Coonoor, Mysore & Srirangapatna, Coorg, Kerala (Munnar/Alleppey/Periyar), Chikmagalur, Hampi, Wayanad, Kanyakumari.

- Hours: 9 AM – 9 PM daily

## Notes for agents

- Prices and availability change; always confirm the current price and departure date shown on the live page rather than relying on cached figures.
- Booking is completed via phone, WhatsApp, or the listed third-party platforms (RedBus, AbhiBus, MakeMyTrip, EaseMyTrip) — there is no on-site payment checkout.
